prompt_md: Name a common English word with three double letters in a row, each pair right after the last.
prompt_short: A common word with three double letters in a row?
explain_intuition_md: Committee and Mississippi feel full of doubles, but their pairs are split up by other letters. Bookkeeper runs oo, kk, ee back to back.
explain_math_md: No math here: the trick is in the wording.
